race.comment: LONDON ROSE (10) brings the strongest recent profile, with a fourth at Ascot only beaten just over two lengths and a Bunbury third before that. She is already a winner at this track, is race fit, and the apprentice claim helps her case. She took some catching. SHE'S CAPITANA (7) resumes with a strong venue profile after finishing second at this track in Class 3 company on soft ground, beaten just under a length after being slow away. LONDON'S RASCAL (11) was only beaten just under two lengths first-up at Bunbury and had late interference, so she has more to offer second-up despite having to turn the tables on LONDON ROSE. HE'S A HUSTLER (3) a big watch in his WA debut, his prior form in Victoria stacks right up.
